min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends (2027 rule)

values.note: All 64 sites reserve site-specific on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov). 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends (Friday-Sunday or Saturday-Monday). Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground. 20 sites are marked long-term.

values.note: 64 reservable utility sites around one loop: 34 pull-through, 30 back-in; 44 gravel and 20 concrete pads. Ten full-hookup sites (50-53, 59-64) have a horse stall or corral. The booking catalog gives no site lengths.

season.source: https://www.campitks.gov/camping/sand-hills-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=511944 ('Open year round.'); KDWP 'The campsites will continue to have water at them throughout the winter', read 2026-11-06

note: KDWP park in sand-prairie dunes 2 mi NE of Hutchinson, with 14 miles of hiking and horse trails; the campground is one loop around a small wetland, entered from 56th Street. In winter (from November 2, 2026 until about mid-April) the water to the shower house and the dump rinse hose is off; the sites keep water. No lake in the park. --Claude
summary: campitks per-site catalog: 64 reservable sites (44 full hookup, 20 W/E, all 50/30/20 A; 34 pull-through), open year round, showers/dump, 2027 holiday 3-night minimum, 14-night max; horse stalls on 10 sites (note said 14). Not waterfront; pads gravel/concrete. Pin fine. Fees as stored.
flags: Website: replace the ReserveAmerica explore link with the campitks link per the KS standard: 'https://www.ksoutdoors.gov/about-kdwp/where-we-work/state-parks/sand-hills' + 'https://www.campitks.gov/camping/sand-hills-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=511944'.
Phone 316-542-3664 confirmed: the KDWP Sand Hills page lists it (it is the Cheney State Park office, which manages Sand Hills). KDWP HQ 620-672-5911 also shown.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront): CONFIRMED. The loop circles a reed-filled wetland with a few small open-water patches (well under 5 acres); KDWP says the park's ponds are along the trails. No lake.
Sand rule: not a candidate. Every pad is gravel (44) or concrete (20) on the paved/gravel park loop; the dunes are the trail area.
Pin 38.1134,-97.8559 is at the centre of the loop (site points centre 38.1131,-97.8559): fine.
Long-term: 20 of 64 sites (014-029, 046-049) are KDWP long-term sites; the other 44 sell nightly. State park, so the private long-stay tests don't apply; noted in booking.note like Milford.

Horse sites: the note's '14 with horse pens' (from older sources) is 10 by the booking catalog (50-53, 59-64); those are ordinary full-hookup RV sites with a stall/corral. General RV campground, not horse-only.

KDWP's park text still says 'Modern facilities are limited to two vault toilets' (the trail area, written before the campground); the campground itself has the shower house. vault_toilets not written.

Fees left as stored (KDWP statewide schedule from 2026-11-01), the KS shape of 2085/2108. Sites 054-058 are water-and-electric by type but carry no 'Water Hookup' attribute in the catalog; counted as W/E by type only.
max_rig_ft not written: the campitks catalog gives no length for any site (inclusion_evidence's '40-ft RV limit' came from a search result and isn't on these pages).
